faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions here

q1.question: Is my data safe?
q1.answer: Yes, all your data is secured with bank-grade encryption and regularly backed up in the cloud. Only you can view your data.

q2.question: Does it work without internet?
q2.answer: Yes, Shohoj Hishab works in offline mode. You can make sales even without internet. All data will automatically sync when you get internet connection.

q3.question: How do I get customer support?
q3.answer: We provide support in Bengali via phone, WhatsApp, and email. Our team is ready to help you from 9 AM to 9 PM.

q4.question: How much mobile data will it use?
q4.answer: Very little! Only 1-2 MB of data per day. And if you work in offline mode, no data is used at all.

q5.question: Can I upgrade from Free to Pro plan?
q5.answer: Yes, you can upgrade anytime. All your data will remain and you'll get new features. You can also downgrade.

q6.question: Can I manage multiple shops?
q6.answer: Yes, in the Pro plan you can add multiple branches or shops and view accounts for each separately.

section1.content1: By using the Shohoj Hishab app, you agree to these terms and conditions. This service is digital accounting software for small and medium businesses in Bangladesh that helps with sales, stock management, and financial accounting.
section1.content2: If you do not agree with these terms, please refrain from using this service. We reserve the right to change these terms at any time, and your use of the app after changes means you agree to the new terms.

section2.title: User Responsibilities

section2.item2: It is your responsibility to keep your login information confidential and not share it with others.
section2.item3: You may not conduct any illegal activities through the app.
section2.item4: You should regularly backup your business information to ensure security.

section3.title: Subscription & Payment
section3.content1: Shohoj Hishab offers different subscription plans. Fees will apply according to your selected plan:
section3.item1: Free Plan: Lifetime free with limited features.
section3.item2: Pro Plan: Monthly ৳999 or Annual ৳9,999 (2 months free).
section3.item3: Subscription renewal is automatic unless you cancel it. Our refund policy is detailed on our refund page.

section4.title: Prohibited Activities
section4.content1: You agree to refrain from the following activities:
section4.prohibited1: Reverse engineering or copying the app's code.
section4.prohibited4: Uploading harmful code or malware to the app's servers.

section5.title: Disclaimer

section5.content2: We are not responsible for loss of your business information, reduced profits, or other indirect damages. It is your responsibility to regularly backup your data.

section1.title: Introduction
section1.content1: Shohoj Hishab takes your privacy very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal and business information.
section1.content2: By using our services, you consent to the collection and use of information as described in this privacy policy. We value your trust and are committed to protecting your data.

section2.title: Information We Collect
section2.intro: We collect the following information to improve your experience and provide services:

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.items: Name, phone number, email address, business name and address.

business.title: Business Information
business.items: Product information, sales records, customer information, stock data, profit-loss accounts.

transaction.title: Transaction Information
transaction.items: Payment methods, transaction history, invoice data.

technical.title: Technical Information
technical.items: Device information, IP address, browser type, location (with your permission).

section3.title: How We Use Information
section3.use1: To create and manage your account.
section3.use2: To generate sales, stock, and financial reports.
section3.use3: To process payments and manage subscriptions.
section3.use4: To provide customer support and resolve technical issues.
section3.use5: To improve our services and add new features.

section4.title: Data Security
section4.content1: We protect your data using industry-standard security measures:
section4.measure1: Encryption: All sensitive data is encrypted.
section4.measure2: Cloud Backup: Regular automatic backups are taken.
section4.measure3: Access Control: Only authorized personnel can access data.
section4.measure4: Secure Servers: Our servers are hosted in secure data centers.

section5.title: Third-Party Sharing
section5.content1: We do not sell your information. However, we may share with third parties in the following cases:
section5.no1: For payment processing (such as: bKash, Nagad, Rocket).

section6.title: Cookies & Tracking
section6.content1: We use cookies to improve your experience and analyze app usage. You can disable cookies from your browser settings if you want.
section6.content2: We use Google Analytics and other analysis tools that help improve our service. These tools do not collect personally identifiable information.

section7.title: Your Rights
section7.content1: According to Bangladesh's Digital Security Act, you have the following rights:
section7.right1: The right to view and correct your personal information.
section7.right2: The right to download a copy of your data.
section7.right3: The right to delete your account and all data.
section7.right4: The right to opt-out of marketing communications.

section8.title: Policy Updates
section8.content1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. For important changes, we will notify you via email or app notification. Please review this page regularly.
